pages.title: Other Features
pages.text:
- **Creative tabs:** Blocks, Tools, Combat, and Ingredients, grouped by material.
- **Advancements:** one for each material, the Alloy Forge, and the Infernium upgrade, in their own tab.
- **Equip sounds:** each armor set has its own.

pages.title: Compatibility
pages.text:
Ores, raw materials, ingots, nuggets, and storage blocks use the common c: tags, so other mods' machines and recipes recognize them.

With JEI or REI installed, the Alloy Forge has its own recipe category.
